description: Read current managed database memory, total storage, region and observed state without running SQL or waking the database. Shared Dev/Prod resolves to one physical database. First provisioning is distinct from cold (sleeping) and warm (running). A null database means no confirmed placement. A configured size does not prove an in-progress resize finished. This read never resizes or changes billing.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.
